_meta.role: investigator (C001 theory track, Stage 4 analysis inputs D1-D3)
_meta.scope: read-only investigation; nothing in the project was edited. Generator-level probes ran in the scratchpad only (nice 15, single process, ~9.5 CPU-min total, tt=None so no Pythia MPI-init file was read or written). _meta.tags: VERIFIED = read from a file or reproduced exactly; ESTIMATE = probe/arithmetic with stated statistics; UNVERIFIED = external number not cited in the repo

rule_text.formula: B = N_trig x [P_PU + P_SM,HS + sum_t rate_t P(pass|t)] + B_cosmic + B_halo (VERIFIED, acts/stage4/WP_RULE.md:313)
rule_text.rate_t_unit: 'per triggered event in the road' (VERIFIED, WP_RULE.md:316)
rule_text.missing_samples: 'tt 2l, single top, VV enter N_trig only' (VERIFIED, WP_RULE.md:326) -> N_trig is a sum over ALL SM processes, incl. ones without hit-level samples
rule_text.normalisation: 'Pythia sigma x K-factor (NNLO/LO ~1.2-1.4, to be cited) with a +-30 % nuisance' (VERIFIED, WP_RULE.md:327); K itself UNVERIFIED (plan.md:1481, 2098)
rule_text.selection_stage: NOT fixed. The rule says 'triggered'; plan §3 defines trigger = L1+HLT MET turn-on T50 = 200 GeV (plan.md:1027-1040) and a separate offline preselection MET > 250, jet > 100, dphi > 0.5, e/mu/tau_h/gamma vetoes (plan.md:1041-1048); the signal chain uses eps_trig x eps_presel (plan.md:1049).

1.28e8.what: p6 N_3ab_sum 9.1209e7 (Z(nunu)+j 14.558 pb + W(lnu)+j 15.845 pb, LO Pythia, truth MET(nu) > 200 GeV, no vetoes, no tt/top/VV) x K 1.4

3.3e7.what: plan's 'about 3-5 x 10^7 after the lepton vetoes and a 250 GeV threshold' (plan.md:1062-1063) -- no script or JSON computes it. 3.3e7 = 0.1 / 3e-9, i.e. the inverse of the planning target P_PU <~ 3e-9 that was itself set from N ~ 3e7 (CRITICAL_REVIEW_S4PLAN_R1.md:291 'B_PU = 0.1 at 3 x 10^7 gives P = 3.3 x 10^-9'); first written as N_trig ~ 3.3e7 in REVIEW_S4PLAN_R3.md:341 and hard-coded in probes/f3r_campaigns.py:155 for the reach arithmetic (plan.md:881).

D1_N_trig.discrepancy_explained: 1.28e8 / 3.3e7 = 3.87 = K 1.4 (not in 3.3e7) x 2.76 (MET 200 -> 250 GeV threshold + lepton vetoes, an un-computed ESTIMATE). The two numbers are different selection stages: truth MET > 200 without vetoes (p6, also the SM-sample definition) vs after the offline preselection (plan sizing). 3.3e7 is circular (derived from the planning P target) and has no provenance as a normalisation.
D1_N_trig.consistency_with_implementation: VERIFIED: the SM terms are weighted sigma_s x K x L / n_ev on truth-MET > 200 samples with NO trigger efficiency, NO MET > 250, NO vetoes (analysis/background.py:662, code/s4pu.py:195 MET_MIN = 200). So the B sum as implemented treats every truth-MET > 200 event as 'triggered'. N_trig with the same population keeps P_PU, C' and SM terms on one footing.

recommended.definition: reading (a): N_trig = L x K x sum_processes sigma(truth MET > 200 GeV), L = 3e6 pb^-1, K = 1.4 (rule upper end), processes = Z(nunu)+j 14.558 + W(lnu)+j 15.845 (p6) + tt 1l 2.76 pb (this probe, D3) = 33.16 pb -> 1.393e8. tt 2l, single top and VV (rule: 'enter N_trig only') are NOT yet computed (UNVERIFIED, expected a few %; same generator-level probe, minutes).
recommended.why_not_1.28e8: 1.28e8 omits tt 1l (+9 %) and the rule's missing samples, so it is NOT the conservative value under reading (a); it is conservative only relative to 3.3e7.
recommended.alternative_b: reading (b): N_trig after trigger + offline preselection (MET > 250 smeared, jet, dphi, vetoes), plan's 3-5e7 (never computed). Computable at generator level from the s4pu HardScatter events in < 0.5 CPU-h. If chosen, the SM terms should get the same preselection for consistency (they currently do not, which is conservative).
recommended.user_decision: YES (selection-stage definition; moves every B84 linearly by up to x3.9-4.3). Recommendation: (a) ~1.4e8 as the conservative pre-registered reading; never 3.3e7 as is.

D2_rate_t.what_the_rule_says: rate_t per triggered event in the road, from Pythia at generator level; P(pass|t) from guns/toys (VERIFIED, WP_RULE.md:316; plan.md:1295 'rate per event in the road from Pythia, generator level'; plan.md:1471 'generator level, unlimited statistics'; CONSTRUCTIVE_REVIEW_S4PLAN_R1.md:258). NI: B_NI = sum_r (NIs/event at r) x P_PV-line 0.22 x P(pass|r) x N_trig (WP_RULE.md:318-320); DIF: no PV-line factor (WP_RULE.md:321).

It was never scheduled (an un-costed analysis-time generator input), not dropped from a job. G1_REPORT.md:188 and s4cp.py:12 note that the V0 charged BR 'enters rate_t'.

definition_choices_for_the_user_or_orche: phi window: +-0.1 rad (gun AIM, s4cp.py:37) vs +-0.15 rad (delta95 road): x1.5 on every rate; +-0.15 is the conservative one

spectrum: guns are log-uniform in pT; plan.md:1269 says P(pass) is 'folded with the Pythia photon spectrum'. analysis/background.py cprime_term averages P flat over the gun spectrum. Folding needs the gun parent pT per C'0/C'_PU event (recoverable from the stored toy SimHits).
NI parents with pT < 0.5 GeV and DIF modes other than mu nu are outside the toy phase space (no P(pass) for them)
which HS sample defines 'per triggered event': sigma-weighted mix of Z/W/tt (rates above differ by <= x1.5 except gamma in tt, x3.8); max over samples is conservative
D2_rate_t.recommended: MUST BE PRODUCED (not in any campaign); < 0.5 CPU-h generator-level Pythia with the s4cp phase space. Preliminary ESTIMATEs above are usable for a dry run, with NI rates either x0.22 in the input or the 0.22 added in cp_terms.
D2_rate_t.user_decision: Partly: the phi window (+-0.1 vs +-0.15) and spectrum folding are definitional choices with a clear conservative default; the rest is mechanical.

bias_in_stored_metadata.finding: s4pu.HardScatter.generate (s4pu.py:242-266) counts a failed py.forceHadronLevel() (l.254) as a try and moves on. About 24-25 % of hadronisation attempts fail, independent of MET within statistics (fraction with parton MET > 200: 0.43 failed vs 0.45 ok for Z). sigma = hs_sigma_gen x N_acc / sum(hs_tries) is therefore biased LOW by the per-try failure fraction r.
bias_in_stored_metadata.check: with failures excluded, Z = 14.58 pb, reproducing p6 14.558 pb (p6_xsec.json:5); as stored it would be 11.24 pb (-23 %).
bias_in_stored_metadata.fix: use sigma = sigma_gen x N_acc / (T - N_hadfail): either divide the stored-metadata value by (1 - r) per sample, or count failures in a generator-only rerun of the stored event seeds (chain_meta.event_seeds -> hseed('hs', seed)); the physics of the accepted events is unaffected.

W_tau_50_50_weighting.decision: G1 executor split each W(tau nu) block 50/50 inclusive / forced-hadronic (G1_REPORT.md:166-180, 310 decision 2; run_stage4.py:85-92); orchestrator ACCEPTED 'with correct weights' (LOG.md:191).

W_tau_50_50_weighting.correct_weights: B_Wtau = L K [sigma_taul P_taul + sigma_tauh P_tauh], sigma_tauh = 0.648 sigma_Wtau = 3.48-3.56 pb, sigma_taul = 0.352 sigma_Wtau = 1.89 pb; P_taul from the tau_l events of Wtaunu_j only; P_tauh from the pooled tau_h events of Wtaunu_j (~64 %) and all of Wtauhnu_j. Per-event weights: tau_l event w = sigma_taul K L / N_taul,incl; tau_h event w = sigma_tauh K L / (N_tauh,incl + N_Wtauhnu).
W_tau_50_50_weighting.needs: per-event tau decay class of the inclusive sample: not in the outputs; regenerate the HS only from the stored event seeds (generator-only, ~0.08 s/event, ~2-3 CPU-min for C1's 1000 events).
W_tau_50_50_weighting.fallback_if_no_class: use the inclusive sample alone (sigma_Wtau = 5.37 pb, unbiased) and Wtauhnu_j as a cross-check, or keep the double count as an explicitly conservative bound (<= x2 on this term).
